notes: SilentCat (src/SilentCat.sol) is a plain, fixed-supply OpenZeppelin v5.1 ERC-20. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 SCAT (18 decimals, 1000000000000000000000000000 minor units) once to msg.sender, the launch factory. There is no mint function, minter role, owner, pause, blacklist, freeze, tax, fee or burn on transfer, so every launch flow (the transfer to the MerkleDistributor, the single-sided seed through the Uniswap v4 PoolManager, and swaps either way) moves exactly what it says. The only extra function is burn(uint256), which destroys the caller's own tokens; there is no burnFrom. The runtime contains no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT and no external calls. There are no application contracts. The pool pairs with IMD at 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7 at the launch policy's 1.25% fee with tick spacing 60; initialPrice is provenance only, the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply.
